_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same directory as package.json) and edit paths for your machine. Values here take precedence over built-in fallbacks but are overridden by environment variables (LIL_ASR_PYTHON, LIL_TTS_PYTHON, LIL_WAKEWORD_PYTHON, LIL_ASR_MODEL, LIL_ASR_PORT, LIL_TTS_PORT, LIL_WAKEWORD_PORT, LIL_ASR_LANGUAGE) and runtime UI settings.
